verdict.rationale: Postman documents and hosts an official remote MCP server (mcp.postman.com) and an MCP Generator/gateway registration flow, letting agents connect via MCP; a hands-on probe confirms the endpoint is live and speaks JSON-RPC (401 due to missing API key, not a functional failure). Missing for 10: an end-to-end example of a specific agent (e.g., Claude/Cursor) successfully connecting and completing a task, and independent community corroboration of real-world usage.
